metadata.title: Audit Trail & Data Integrity for Master Data

story.iWant: I want to review master-data audit trails and run automated integrity checks
story.soThat: so that we maintain traceable change history and quickly surface orphaned records before they impact downstream modules

task.title: Expand audit logging services (AC: #3, #4, #6)
task.subtask: Extend AuditLogService to record IP address and user-agent metadata on each audit entry.
Persist blocked modification attempts with actor context, company scope, and reason codes.
Emit per-row audit entries from batch and import facades for both success and failure paths.

task.title: Deliver RBAC-aware audit retrieval APIs (AC: #2)
task.subtask: Expose REST endpoints under backend/src/main/java/com/accounting/controller/admin with pagination and export support.
Implement repository filters for company scope, date range, user email, and action type.
Return response envelopes following the { data, error?, meta? } contract with export manifest hashes.

task.title: Build audit log UI experiences (AC: #1, #2, #6)
task.subtask: Create React feature module at frontend/src/features/audit with TanStack Table, search, refresh, and page size selector (10/20/30/50/100).
Wire export controls to new backend APIs and enforce role guards inside ProtectedLayout routing.
Localize table copy in English and Vietnamese, including audit result metadata and status badges.

task.title: Implement automated data integrity scans (AC: #5)
task.subtask: Introduce DataIntegrityService routines to detect orphaned customers, suppliers, and chart-of-accounts entries.
Expose an admin-only endpoint to run scans, persist findings, and log each execution.
Throttle scan scheduling per company and emit audit entries for each run with execution metadata.

testing.item: AC1: Validate UI filtering by user, action, and date across master-data entities with RBAC guards enforced.
AC2: API integration tests confirm company scoping, export payload metadata, and role restrictions.
AC3: Unit tests assert audit records include field diffs, actor identity, IP address, and user agent attributes.
AC4: Negative tests simulate blocked modifications and expect audit entries describing the rejection.
AC5: Integrity scan integration test detects seeded orphan records and logs an audit trail of the run.
AC6: Import and batch tests ensure per-row audit entries are produced for successful and failed outcomes.

criterion.title: Audit Log UI
criterion.detail: Deliver audit log views per master-data entity (customers, suppliers, chart of accounts, bank accounts) with filters for date range, user, and action.

criterion.title: RBAC Audit APIs
criterion.detail: Expose company-scoped, role-protected REST endpoints that return filtered audit logs and export payloads for compliance reviews.

criterion.title: Rich Audit Payload
criterion.detail: Persist audit entries capturing record type, field-level diffs, user email and role, timestamp, IP address, and user agent metadata.

criterion.title: Failed Modification Telemetry
criterion.detail: Detect and log blocked modification attempts so governance teams can identify abuse or misuse patterns.

criterion.title: Integrity Scan Endpoint
criterion.detail: Provide an admin-only endpoint that scans for orphaned master data, reports findings, and logs each execution.

criterion.title: Batch Transparency
criterion.detail: Ensure bulk imports and batch operations emit per-row audit entries for both success and failure outcomes.

artifact.title: Epic 2 Technical Specification
artifact.section: Story 2.7: Audit Trail & Data Integrity for Master Data
artifact.snippet: 1. UI "Audit Log" per entity: shows all changes for that customer/supplier/account, filterable by date/user/action type. 2. Exposes audit log API for download/filtering (respecting role-based access). 3. Log format includes: record type, affected fields (old/new), user/email/role, datetime, IP/user agent if present.

artifact.title: Story 2.6: Data Import & Migration
artifact.snippet: Import attempt logs inserted/skipped/error counts and per-row audit entries capturing before/after payloads where applicable. Validate/import up to 1,000 rows in ≤ 30s; for larger sets, provide chunking or background strategy note (out of scope to build fully now).

artifact.title: Security Architecture
artifact.snippet: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO. API-level permission checks. Audit trail: Immutable append-only logs.

artifact.title: RBAC Testing Guide
artifact.section: Test 3: Chief Accountant User - Management Access
artifact.snippet: Objective: Verify chief accountant can manage users and access company settings. Expected Results: Company Settings menu item visible; User Management menu item visible. Test Access: Navigate to `/company` → page loads; navigate to `/users` → page loads.

file.reason: Central audit service already captures IP, user agent, import row telemetry, and REQUIRES_NEW writes—extend to master-data CRUD, failed attempts, and integrity scan events.
Current schema lacks companyId, entity metadata, and JSON diffs required by AC3/AC4—identify gaps for migration planning.
JSONB-backed per-row import auditing pattern to reuse for master-data batch transparency (AC6).
Demonstrates RBAC enforcement, company context checks, and audit logging hooks guiding new audit log and integrity endpoints.
Existing TanStack Table implementation with search, refresh, page-size selector, and pagination to mirror in audit log UI (AC1).

backend.dep: Spring Boot 3.5.x (Web, Data JPA, Security) for audit APIs, company scoping, and RBAC guards.
PostgreSQL + Flyway for JSONB audit storage, partition strategies, and schema migrations.
SpringDoc OpenAPI for documenting new audit and integrity endpoints.

frontend.dep: React 18 + @tanstack/react-table 8.x for interactive audit log tables with filtering and pagination.
shadcn/ui (Dialog, Select, Table) and Lucide icons for consistent admin tooling UX.
React Query + Axios for RBAC-aware data fetching, export triggers, and optimistic refresh.

tooling.dep: JUnit 5 + Testcontainers for integration tests covering audit log persistence and integrity scans.
Vitest + Testing Library + MSW for verifying audit UI filters, role guards, and localized copy.

constraints.item: Audit trail must remain append-only with REQUIRES_NEW transactions and include companyId, actor metadata, and field diffs per AC3.
All audit log and integrity endpoints require ADMIN or CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT roles and enforce CompanyContext scoping (X-Company-Id header).
Integrity scans must throttle per company and log invocation metadata (actor, timestamp, scope) to prevent abuse.
Bulk operations must emit per-row ImportAuditEntry payloads while keeping main transaction latency within 30s for 1k rows.
Frontend audit tables must match platform accessibility patterns (keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, localized English/Vietnamese copy).

standards.item: Backend: Spring Boot + Testcontainers PostgreSQL verifying audit persistence, RBAC guards, and integrity scan orchestration.
Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library with MSW to simulate audit APIs, filter interactions, and Vietnamese copy.
Ops: Manual regression using RBAC Testing Guide to confirm admin/chief-only access.

ideas.item: AC1: UI test loads audit logs for customers, applies user/action/date filters, verifies pagination controls.
AC2/AC3: Integration test confirms audit entries store entity metadata, user email/role, IP, and user agent; RBAC denies ACCOUNTANT role.
AC4: Service test simulates blocked delete (e.g., customer with invoices) and asserts audit entry with failure reason.
AC5: Integrity scan test seeds orphaned supplier references, runs endpoint, and expects findings plus audit log record.
AC6: Import facade test ensures per-row ImportAuditEntry writes for success/failure rows with attempt metadata.
